CD-M1.title: Rule 14.144's R-38 state draws a connection R-38 does not target.
CD-M1.what_and_fix: Where: `s-14-144-correct`, from `phase3_ch14_complex_build.py`. What: `.sv .crt .ak-case{stroke:var(--oa-color-graphic-essential);stroke-width:6px}` applies to L39's group at all times; each "unchosen reform" rule resets `.ak-mark` to 2 px but never resets `.ak-case`, so with R-38 checked L39 draws as a 6 px black stroke, heavier than any other line (seen in `states/s-14-144-correct--R-38.png`). Fix: add `.ak-case{stroke:none}` to each `.p:has([value="R-nn"]:checked) [data-oa-for]:not([data-oa-for~="R-nn"])` rule, or move the case into the checked rules as 15.20 does; recapture all three states on both grounds. Owner: complex examples maker; component engineer reads it; data lead signs off.
CD-M1.owner: complex examples maker; component engineer reads it; data lead signs off

CD-M2.title: Rule 15.22's veto stage splits two sentences into columns.
CD-M2.what_and_fix: Where: `s-15-22-correct`, stage 10, from `phase3_ch15_build.py` (`.wf .sq{display:flex;gap:8px}`). What: "Short of", the `nw2` span "two-thirds" and "in either chamber, the bill dies." become three flex items, and "With two-thirds in each, then stage 13." prints with two 8 px gaps. Two lines in the guide, both here (counted by script over every `s-15-*` specimen). Fix: wrap the text after the marker in one span (`Short of two-thirds ...`), rerun the brace check and recapture 15.22 at 1440, 390 and 320 px. Owner: systems designer.
